title: Clinical Trial of Immune-Guided Prevention of CMV Infection in Low-Risk Kidney Transplantation: INMUNOVIR Study.
official:
Efficacy and Safety Clinical Trial for Immune-Guided Prevention of CMV Infection in Low-Risk Kidney Transplantation.
(INMUNOVIR Study)
summary: Main objective: Compare the efficacy and safety of immune-guided prophylaxis with standard clinical practice (preemptive therapy/prophylaxis) in CMV-seropositive kidney transplant recipients.

interventions.name: Valganciclovir Normon 450 mg comprimidos recubiertos con película EFG
Ganciclovir Accord 500 mg polvo para concentrado para solución para perfusión EFG

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. Over 18 years of age
2. CMV-seropositive kidney transplant recipients
3. Must have a negative pregnancy test (non-menopausal women)
4. To have any of the four alleles (two from the human leukocyte antigen A gene and two from the human leukocyte antigen B gene) allowed in the list (see Annex 3).
Exclusion criteria:
1. HIV-infected patients
2. Patients with multivisceral transplants
3. Receiving induction therapy with anti-thymocyte globulin (ATG) at a dose of thymoglobulin greater than 3 mg/kg or an equivalent dose of Grafalon.
4. Unable to comply with the follow-up protocol
5. Having CMV replication/disease prior to inclusion
